name: Doom
short_description: Doom, on a badge or on a desktop
long_description: doomgeneric with one engine per host: a badge runs it from the retro-core flash partition (linked for a fixed address, executed from flash through the cache, driven through c_mpos/core_abi.h), a desktop runs it as a MicroPython native module. Input and output go through MicroPythonOS either way
